scope: Read-only independent mathematical review of current Section3, selected responses and Train_TL_QLDMR.py; no training or parameter selection.

findings.finding: Classification minimum-margin language and an unsupported generic LDMR objective remain in introduction/related work. Hazarika2023 concerns mode decomposition, not mode-seeking.
findings.evidence: The stated +lambda2 Mean(Residuals) formula is not supported by cited original LDMR; with one sample, y=0, w=0, free b>0, L=absolute error, C=1 and lambda2=2, J=-b tends to minus infinity. This counterexample concerns the generic displayed formula, not the corrected Section 3 objective.

findings.finding: Related Work still claims fixed MMD learns a representation and ensures target robustness. Section3 and reply correctly restrict the trainable term to prediction means, creating an internal inconsistency.
findings.evidence: For fixed data and phi, empirical RKHS MMD is constant in w. Dproj=(w^T Delta)^2 equals linear-kernel MMD on scalar outputs, and can vanish with Delta nonzero. It is not full-feature distribution alignment.

findings.finding: Quantile-compatible spread is still motivated only by translation invariance. It should not suggest conditional-quantile preservation, and R1C1 still lacks a precise theoretical comparison.
findings.evidence: An explicit population counterexample changes conditional coverages from tau=.75 to (.8,.7). A fixed-feature complete-square transformation proves exact equivalence to weighted SVQR on transformed features/shifted labels, clarifying the limited methodological change.

findings.finding: Complexity table gives unqualified O(N^3) for whole QP optimization and omits landmark-selection cost.
findings.evidence: For a dense interior-point implementation one dense factorization costs O(N^3); total optimization contains the iteration count I_QP and requested numerical accuracy. Explicit feature costs also contain the pool/KMeans selection cost C_Z. Suggested replacement states these conditions and separates costs.

findings.finding: Prediction vector switches from row notation beta^T K+b1^T to column K beta+b1 in subsequent equations.
findings.evidence: No algebraic consequence because elementwise predictions are consistent, but use one convention for readability.

resolved: Section3 correctly treats residual mean as parameter dependent and uses H1=0 to cancel the intercept.
The full kernel expansion keeps -lambda1 K S Y and the fixed-feature linear c with consistent 1/nS factors.
The exact dual Q=K Omega^dagger K and p=lambda1 K Omega^dagger K S Y-Y have correct signs and ranges.

For PSD K and nonnegative weights, ker(Omega)=ker(K); PSD/PD conditions and minimum-norm recovery are stated correctly. Null(K) coefficients represent the same RKHS weight; this does not imply unique intercept.

R>=I establishes strong convexity in w at fixed b; joint convexity holds; no unwarranted joint strong convexity, Adam convergence rate, or Nystrom approximation-error bound remains in the reviewed Section3.
Train_TL_QLDMR centered_residual regularizer and batch directions match the displayed R,c and summed loss; source pool<=2000, fixed map and declared jitter match the run description.

Legacy symmetric/asymmetric modes are explicitly named prediction-variance models; exact-kernel route rejects unsupported legacy modes; repaired numerical checks are not claimed as large-sample benchmark evidence.

reviewer_status.R1C1: Partly answered: corrected formulation is specified, but exact relation/nesting with established SVQR and accurate original LDMR comparison still needed; no proof of novel statistical advantage can be manufactured.
reviewer_status.R1C5: Core symmetry and convexity corrections are sound; tighten conditional-quantile interpretation and remove conflicting background.
reviewer_status.R2Major5: Core algebra and code consistency addressed; clean residual MMD terminology.
reviewer_status.R2Major6: Core convexity and guarantee scope addressed; complexity qualifications remain.
reviewer_status.R3C3: Core equation addressed; Related Work still contradicts the corrected interpretation.
reviewer_status.R3C4: Symmetric term and pinball asymmetry addressed; theoretical-property wording needs the indicated restriction.

counterexample.scope: Nonvanishing population penalty; no assertion that inherited finite-sample tiny lambda causes a large effect.

implementation_limits: No code or real-data model was modified or rerun. Existing model numerical tests were inspected; this audit ran only analytical counterexample and completing-square checks.

The PSD solver is a numerical pseudoinverse with an eigenvalue tolerance. qpth adds a disclosed 1e-8 dual ridge; torch_gd and Adam are approximate iterative optimizers. A mathematical exact-kernel objective must not be confused with exact arithmetic or guaranteed finite-iteration solver accuracy.
Code observations concern the current file only, not an assumed historical result-generation version.
